clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 OK with response [{"name":"tenant_empty"}] - empty activityStatus accepted

verified_assumptions: Request includes body with array of Tenant objects
activityStatus field is provided in request (albeit empty string)
Expected behavior: API should reject empty activityStatus as invalid enum value

contract_refs: description: Tenant.activityStatus on create must be ACTIVE or INACTIVE

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /schema/{className}/tenants → handlers_schema.go:createTenants() → tenant.go:AddTenants() → validateTenants() → [MISSING: tenants[i].Validate() call]
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:validateTenants()函数只验证租户名称(ValidateTenantName),完全跳过了Tenant.Validate()调用。虽然entities/models/tenant.go有validateActivityStatus()方法,但从未被调用。空字符串被swag.IsZero()判定为'not required'而直接返回nil,导致非法值通过验证。

falsification.probe: 验证合法值也能正常工作: POST with activityStatus=ACTIVE → HTTP 200, POST with activityStatus=INACTIVE → HTTP 200
falsification.observed: 合法枚举值(ACTIVE/INACTIVE)正常工作,证明问题仅在于缺少对非法值的校验

cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation gaps at API boundaries
cognition_match.note: 命中bug_shapes.json的BS-004模式(请求解析中的参数验证问题),开发者认知明确指出'API边界的输入验证经常不完整',本缺陷正是此类问题的典型案例

physical.objective_constraint: activityStatus is an enum field with finite valid values {ACTIVE, INACTIVE}

behavioral.note: API优雅地接受了非法值(返回200而非422),但源码中validateTenants()函数完全没有调用Tenant.Validate(),这显然是遗漏而非有意设计

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED (contract violation) + verdict_B=CONFIRMED (physical constraint violation) + verdict_C=CONFIRMED (not by-design) → final=CONFIRMED

verdicts.rationale: 源码接地发现关键证据:validateTenants()函数在usecases/schema/tenant.go第103-128行只验证租户名称,完全跳过了对Tenant对象本身的Validate()调用。虽然entities/models/tenant.go定义了validateActivityStatus()方法,但它从未被执行。该方法中swag.IsZero()将空字符串视为'not required'直接返回nil,导致空字符串绕过了枚举验证。contract明确要求activityStatus必须是{ACTIVE, INACTIVE}之一,但实际API接受空字符串并返回200,这是典型的Type1_IllegalSuccess参数验证缺失缺陷。
